request.input:
1girl, solo, adult woman, lying on her back on a soft living room rug, playing a four-string electric bass guitar resting across her torso, knees loosely bent, head near the lower right foreground, playful relaxed smile, looking toward the viewer

Wide game homepage wallpaper, a comfortable intimate late-night home music practice moment.

Wide low camera close to the rug. Her body extends diagonally from her head at the lower right toward her bent legs at the upper left. Her silver ponytail fans over the rug beside her head. One black electric bass with a cream pickguard lies across her torso, its long neck points diagonally toward the lower left foreground. Include the entire bass headstock and all four tuning pegs inside the frame. Her LEFT hand wraps naturally around the neck and presses strings just behind frets, her RIGHT index and middle fingertips pluck strings above the body pickups. Both hands are visible. Only four strings from four bridge saddles along the neck to four tuning pegs. A dark sofa, a softly lit desk, plants and a small bass amplifier sit in the background. A blue nighttime city skyline is visible through the large window. Artwork only, no actual interface.

Warm amber desk lamp on the left and cool cobalt blue city window light behind the sofa. Muted charcoal upholstery, lavender pajama trousers, wool sweater, silver-white hair with coherent clean flowing locks, pale warm skin, black lacquer bass body and brushed metal frets, cozy chromatic shadows, controlled detail, high complexity
